messages:
Alex: Heads-up: Bluepine wants to run a 2-week POC next week using a custom model 'bluepine-13b-v2'. They need p95 <100ms for single-user chat, KMS/HSM-backed keys, and answers to a security questionnaire before they share any PII prompts. They also asked about 4-bit quantized variants. Who can check catalog compatibility and give a quick pricing ballpark?
Priya: Ill own compatibility. Do we have the model bundle and config? If it's an adapter/LoRA we need merge details.
Alex: They uploaded a tar to a presigned S3 link: https://s3.bluepine-demo/bluepine-13b-v2.tar.gz (shared privately). No LoRA, full weights included.
Marco: Runtime note: we have q4_0 and q4_k_mlp paths but some scaled-rope variants require kernel tweaks. Need config.json from bundle to confirm attention & norm types. Also need to estimate KV cache for latency sizing.
Jasmine: Onboarding checklist for this thread:
- verify model config (attn type, norm)
- run internal model-checker (tools/model-checker --input model)
- build q4 candidate and run smoke tests
- prepare security questionnaire answers
- POC pricing estimate (hosted vs small dedicated)
- schedule POC kickoff with customer
Priya: Pulled model config locally: norm=rmsnorm, rope_type=scaled_rope. That means well hit the scaled rope code path. Marco, can you confirm kernel coverage?
Marco: Confirmed scaled_rope is supported but q4_k_mlp needs a rope-multiplier patch for kernels. I can run model-checker and produce a q4 candidate; need first 3 sample prompts and the config. ETA ~4 hours.
Elena: Security checklist: they asked for HSM-backed KMS, data residency (EU vs US), and whether embeddings or prompts are logged. Legal needs ~48h to sign off on questionnaire responses. Also we should prepare ISO/SOC artifacts.
Alex: Pricing question: Bluepine is cost-sensitive. For ~30 concurrent clients during POC, 2 weeks, heavy chat usage — Hosted with rate-limits uplift vs a small dedicated GPU pool? Thoughts?
Priya: Hosted is quickest: rough hosted POC cost estimate ~$3.5k for 2 weeks (token heavy). Dedicated short-term gets better latency predictability but has upfront cost (~$15k/month baseline for a small reserved slice). I'll firm numbers after load profile.
Marco: Latency sizing quick calc: tokens_per_session=512, avg_batch=6, kv_entry_est=16 bytes => 512*6*16=49,152 bytes per session. For 30 concurrent sessions ~1.5MB KV memory. Model memory differs when quantized: q4 reduces model mem by ~40%. Long contexts (>4096) change this math.
Jasmine: Can we propose an A/B canary during POC: primary quantized variant with auto-fallback to fp16 hosted variant on regressions?
Marco: Yes, runtime supports policy-based routing. We can set canary -> if latency > threshold or quality drop then fallback to fp16. Will add rollback triggers.
Alex: They also want SOC/ISO docs before sharing PII samples. We can provide ISO27001 + SOC2 Type II summary, but legal asks questionnaire answered first. Bluepine agreed to our standard mutual NDA.
security-bot: quick-scan: presigned link not publicly exposed, bundle hash pattern OK but signature not verified. Recommend verifying S3 signature and rotating link after download.
Priya: Action items: (1) Marco: run model-checker + q4 build (ETA 4h), (2) Jasmine: draft POC plan and fallback strategy, (3) Elena: draft security questionnaire answers (48h), (4) Alex: lock POC dates with customer and request 3 sample prompts.
Alex: I'll schedule the kick-off Tue/Wed and ping Bluepine for HSM confirmation and prompts.
Marco: model-checker output: applied rope-multiplier patch, built q4_k candidate, smoke tests passed on 20/24 unit prompts; 2 failures on very long-context concatenation (>4096 tokens). Investigating root cause.
Priya: Please attach failing prompts so we can reproduce locally.
Marco: Uploaded fail log to results bucket: s3://bluepine/results/fail-cases.log. Fail cases are long-context session concatenations. Fallback to fp16 should handle these.
Jasmine: I'll put notes into the internal catalog issue (#4721) and flag the fallback plan.
Elena: I'll start the questionnaire draft and pull SOC/ISO artifacts for transfer. Legal/compliance will review.
Priya: If a kernel regen is required for production, ping me and Ill reserve a small build slot on the infra queue.
Alex: Thanks all. I'll loop the customer on Friday with initial smoke numbers and the rough hosted/dedicated pricing comparison. :calendar:
